verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
Oh heart of mine
Why must you stray
From One so fair
You run away
And one more time
You have to pay the heaviness
Of needless shame

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
So come home running
His arms are open wide
His name is Jesus
And He understands
He is the answer
You are looking for
So come home running
Just as you are

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Oh heart of mine
Come back home
You've been too long
Out on your own
And He's been there all along
Watching for you down the road

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Oh child of God
So dearly loved
And ransomed by
The Savior's blood
And called by name daughter and son
Wrapped in the robe of righteousness
